series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

verdict.text: Chad pledges a 18.2% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual. A later submission, First NDC (Updated submission), was filed on 2021-10-19; it has not been read, so no figure here comes from it. 54 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (8). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 125.9 MtCO₂e, DS-02 94.9 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 18.2% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. ND-GAIN scores it 26.4 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: Cumulative 18.2% (unconditional) to 71% (conditional) reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the reference scenario, equivalent to a cumulative reduction of about 41,700 GgCO2e (unconditional) to 162,000 GgCO2e (conditional) 2015-2030 It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.2°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.76°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
